messages.subject: Calculating delta time
parts:
Hello,
I have used Wildlife Insights for species identification and would now like to carry on with the creation of detection histories and other analysis using camtrapR. The table I get from Wildlife Insights contains almost all information needed for a record table but it does not have the delta time. I wonder if there is a way to just calculate this missing column.

Thank you,
Sonja
